d.ko: Glory to the Heroes set in the Russian-Ukrainian war is an immersive PvPvE mil-sim providing perspective on the modern warfare with combined-arms combat and extensive elements of survival and immersion, where the action is happening in the accurately recreated real-world locations of actual battles

d.zh: 《Glory to the Heroes》是一款以俄乌战争为背景的沉浸式 PvPvE 军事模拟游戏。在依据真实交战地点还原的战场上，体验多兵种协同作战与前线求生，从普通士兵的视角感受现代战争。
